import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"


def parse_book(b):
    title = b.find("div", class_="book-title").get_text(strip=True)
    author = b.find("div", class_="book-author").get_text(strip=True)
    author = re.sub(r"(?i)^\s*by\s+", "", author).strip()
    year_txt = b.find("span", class_="book-year").get_text(strip=True)
    rating_txt = b.find("span", class_="book-rating").get_text(strip=True)
    price_txt = b.find("span", class_="book-price").get_text(strip=True)
    year = int(re.search(r"(\d+)", year_txt).group(1))
    rating = float(re.search(r"([\d.]+)", rating_txt).group(1))
    price = float(re.search(r"\$?([\d.]+)", price_txt).group(1))
    return {
        "title": title,
        "author": author,
        "year": year,
        "rating": rating,
        "price": price,
    }


def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")
    books = [parse_book(b) for b in soup.find_all("div", class_="book")]

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    highest = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    with open("report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(f"Total number of books scraped: {total}\n")
        f.write(f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}\n")
        f.write(f"Highest rated book: {highest['title']} by {highest['author']} (Rating: {highest['rating']}/5)\n")

    print(df.head())
    print("Total:", total, "Avg price: %.2f" % avg_price)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF

      "keystrokes": "cat > /app/scraper.py << 'EOF'
import re
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import pandas as pd

URL = "http://server:8000"


def parse_book(b):
    title = b.find("div", class_="book-title").get_text(strip=True)
    author = b.find("div", class_="book-author").get_text(strip=True)
    author = re.sub(r"(?i)^\s*by\s+", "", author).strip()
    year_txt = b.find("span", class_="book-year").get_text(strip=True)
    rating_txt = b.find("span", class_="book-rating").get_text(strip=True)
    price_txt = b.find("span", class_="book-price").get_text(strip=True)
    year = int(re.search(r"(\d+)", year_txt).group(1))
    rating = float(re.search(r"([\d.]+)", rating_txt).group(1))
    price = float(re.search(r"\$?([\d.]+)", price_txt).group(1))
    return {
        "title": title,
        "author": author,
        "year": year,
        "rating": rating,
        "price": price,
    }


def main():
    resp = requests.get(URL, timeout=10)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    soup = BeautifulSoup(resp.text, "html.parser")
    books = [parse_book(b) for b in soup.find_all("div", class_="book")]

    df = pd.DataFrame(books, columns=["title", "author", "year", "rating", "price"])
    df.to_csv("books.csv", index=False)

    total = len(df)
    avg_price = df["price"].mean()
    highest = df.loc[df["rating"].idxmax()]

    with open("report.txt", "w") as f:
        f.write(f"Total number of books scraped: {total}\n")
        f.write(f"Average book price: ${avg_price:.2f}\n")
        f.write(f"Highest rated book: {highest['title']} by {highest['author']} (Rating: {highest['rating']}/5)\n")

    print(df.head())
    print("Total:", total, "Avg price: %.2f" % avg_price)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
EOF
